📝 Mayor's Blog Update (Published: August 1, 2026)

On Saturday, August 1st, I attended the renovation ceremony for Hanno Kawara Stage Plaza.

I hope that this newly renovated stage will be used even more going forward—as a place where people can enjoy nature and clear streams, and as a space where business operators can pursue various new ventures.
